reviews.text: Dr. Gladwin and Dr. Kretzschmar have both taken care of my pets and are both equally knowledgable and caring people. I highly recommend them for your pet's healthcare. The staff are also very friendly and helpful. This is a small animal hospital near Tezel and Gilbeau rosds on the northwest side. I find it to be more conviently located than the previous vet I had been using.

I feel so safe taking my dogs and cats here over the years. The new owner Dr K.. is so smart and caring. I’ve met the other vet also are all are very through, kind and knowledgeable. Great vet staff as well.

I just started taking my pup there after a recommendation form another pet parent.
This is not a conglomerate group! The staff and doctors are great.  They took the safe conservative method rather than the aggressive one and it worked. Thank you team!
Always friendly and haven't had any issues with any of the staff members.

I just got off the phone with a young lady. I was calling to correct some information on my pet's record. This young lady answered pleasantly, but when I explained why I was calling, I heard a snarky tone in her voice. I stated the reason for the call and waited for her to prompt me into providing the information she needed to look up my pet's record. There was silence followed by impatience. I stated my name and she asked for the pet's name. I gave her the information and again waited for a prompt. Again, a moment of silence followed by "Okay, so what's the problem?" in a condescending tone. I gave her the information . While she , I assumed, was entering the info, I commented that when I clicked the link to complete the check in process, that the incorrect item in question could not be manually changed to correct it and that's why I called. I was basically suggesting that maybe the program could be tweaked to allow the client to change info since it asks for you to verify the info as correct. She did not acknowledge my concern and instead went straight to "Well, thanks for calling", again in a snarky tone. I have been a client for nearly 40 years and never experienced rudeness. I have always been welcomed with kindness and compassion. This was a first, but I felt it was important to call out since this person is the frontline representing a practice that has always exhibited professionalism and courtesy.
Great vets that actually take the time to talk to pet owners and very reasonably priced!
Amazing staff and very knowledgeable, super friendly. We love guilbeau station animal hosp. We been bringing our Titan Rottweiler there for 6+ years with out any issues.  Highly recommended.

We lost our boy, my daughter’s(we loved him as our grandpup earlier this month. It was VERRRYYY emotional and 5 minutes until close the day he passed, June 10. Also it was a Spurs final game. The staff did not hesitate to help us to rush him to the back to do everything that they could possibly do . When I mean, the STAFF, I mean from the receptionist to the people that directed my husband were to Lay or a boy before he was Pronounced, Even the tech pronounce our boy were so kind and helpful. They help with directing us to who can do Autopsy services along with cremation services.  They made this difficult transition as smooth as they could. Office is super sweet. We just got our Gunner this afternoon and by everything we received back… It was so heartfelt 🙏🏽 Thank you all so much for taking care of our boy
Great Vet and employees who really care about their patients. Dr. K is a kind and compassionate Dr.

I've been coming to Guilbeau Station now for my senior dog for almost a year. Every single member of staff from the vets, to the techs, to reception, and anyone in between has been fantastic. They're kind, treat my boy well, work with me on what he needs vs what I can afford. Their prices are fair, the vets listen when I've come in with what could be considered trivial issues, they educate on any health issue he's had and how I can best continue care at home, and at least 1-2 staff members will greet him enthusiastically when we pop in for happy visits or med refills.

If you're looking for a locally/vet owned, neighborhood clinic, this is the place for you. They may not have all the frills of a bigger or corporate owned facility, but that's perfect for my old man and I. We're utterly thankful to have found Guilbeau Station.
Best care and the staff are wonderful. We are new to Texas and their caring staff took both our dogs in a family would.

We had a great experience. The staff were very welcoming . They took great care of my pup and made us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. Overall, a great experience and we would definitely recommend them!

Please do not bring your pets here.

We took my 83-year-old grandmother’s dog in to be humanely euthanized after he had been suffering, and the experience was absolutely devastating. The vet missed his vein, and instead of a peaceful passing, my grandmother had to watch her beloved dog struggle to breathe for nearly 10 minutes.

No one should have to witness something like that—especially not in a moment that’s supposed to be handled with care, compassion, and dignity. My grandmother is completely traumatized, and I am beyond furious.

I would strongly urge others to reconsider bringing their animals here.

Needed a same day appt because my dogs paw was bleeding. Guilbeau station Animal Hospital was able to see my dog the quickest out of the 10 vets I called in a hurry to get my dog seen asap. The appt was quick, staff was amazing and friendly and office was very clean and put together. The appt and medicine was also priced reasonably. Highly recommend.
Caring staff. Dr explains everything answers all questions and cares about his patients
Great help from the visit!!

We visited Guilbeau Station animal hospital for the first time, and I honestly couldn't be more impressed.  Wonderful staff !!!!, but Evan truly saved the day. My dog unexpectedly got loose almost ran into the street, nearly getting hit by a car. Evan reacted immediately and stepped in without hesitation, keeping my dog safe. His quick action, calmness, and genuine care meant everything to us. That moment alone showed how much this team truly cares about the animals they serve. Highly recommend this place!!

I am so pleased with the care we’ve received at Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital. Dr. Kretzschmar and the whole team have been so kind, patient, and reassuring every time we’ve been in. We happily drive 45 minutes to see them because we truly trust them with our pets.

They were especially wonderful with my cat, who is very timid and shy. She got sick with a virus our new rescue brought home, and they handled her so gently, kept her calm, and made sure she felt safe the entire visit. It meant so much to see how attentive and caring they were with her.

Their prices are also very competitive, which just makes the experience even better.

I’d recommend this hospital to anyone looking for a vet who genuinely cares and goes the extra mile. We’re so grateful for them!
Dr. Tim is the best there is.
They recently changed ownership which was a bummer.  My family and I have used this place for over 30 years. They’re still great even with the new ownership.

My first visit there was today.My young dog had a seizure.  They saw me within 30 minutes of the episode. Staff and Vet were professional and understanding. Process was explained to me perfectly. I will be taking my dog there from now on.
Amazing to have a vet who listens to what you've tried and is ready to try something different. Really happy with the service!
Highly recommend Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital.  Everyone from the front desk staff to the vet was kind and patient with my 11 year old dog that gets vet anxiety.  Thank you!!!
Friendly, caring staff. It was our first visit but they made us feel like we have always gone. Definitely recommend.
The staff is excellent, friendly and great to talk to.

I have been with them for years! They are the best! They really care for each of the pets that come through the door. We have two anxious cats and they handled them with such delicate care that our girls didn’t hiss or bite. I cannot recommend this team enough. From the front desk to the techs and the vets, they are amazing.
Very attentive and caring staff!
I loved the Vet the staff were friendly, CANT ASK FOR MORE THAN THAT!!!

In one of the hardest moments of my life, I’m incredibly grateful for the compassion and care shown by the staff at Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital. My mother’s elderly dog, Maggie, was nearing the end of her life, and making the decision to say goodbye was not easy. From the very beginning, the team here was warm, understanding, and patient. They didn’t rush anything — they took the time to talk with me, explain the process, and treat Maggie with the kindness and dignity she deserved.
It’s clear they care about both pets and their families. Their empathy helped bring comfort during such a difficult time, and their professionalism made everything feel a little more bearable. The cost was very reasonable, which also helped relieve some of the stress.
Thank you to everyone at Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital. Your kindness made all the difference. I will never forget how respectfully and lovingly you helped us through this moment.

One of my dogs had her end of life care done through here. They were all so compassionate and gave us options and a whole lot of love to our family and furry family member. I couldn't have asked for a better place to say goodbye.

Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital  loves my pets as much as we do. Everyone is family here.
I'd like to add a new comment about the recent experience we had while in for our aging friend, George the rat terrier. We have had wonderful advise and care over the five + years that George had been with us. The advise that Dr Graham had given was always of value especially at the end of his days. We wish to thank her for her honest and kind advise when the going got rough.
They suck
Incredibly sensitive to you and your needs, great bedside manor, could not recommend highly enough.
I've been taking my furry family for the past 13 years.  I refuse to go elsewhere.  A friendly and caring place for your pets.
The people at this animal hospital are so wonderful. They were so caring and the vet was absolutely fantastic. They got me in and helped me with my little dog and made us both feel a lot better.

I highly recommend Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital! I was seen right away for our appointment, the staff and vet were so kind and caring for my dog, Sapphire. He showed true concern and patience when I asked questions.

If you’re looking for a great vet, I recommend them 🐾
Wanting to establish my pet as a new patient. I was on hold for 15 minutes, and no one assisted.

This place is great for my cat
Dasher good with him and
They have his food

This will be where I take my little Lucyfur as long as they live. They’re both professional and friendly. I don’t expect anyone to be happy every single day of their job, but I’ve never encountered an unpleasant attitude there. It puts me at ease and I’m sure it helps keep my dog calm.
Caring Vet that will get their patients in quick when your pet is sick.
Dr. Kretzchmar and staff were wonderful seeing our dog on short notice. We will definitely be going back to Dr. Kretzchmar's office. Highly recommend!
We followed Dr Tim and we are so happy we found him! The staff is awesome and Dr Tim is wonderful to my Pet !!! Thank Dr Tim we love u!

A heartfelt thank you to everyone at Guilbeau Station Animal Hospital for their outstanding attention and care! We have been longtime patients of Dr. Tim Kretzschmar, and we couldn’t be more thrilled to have found him at his own practice, continuing to care for our beloved cats.

Dr. Tim is truly exceptional—he treats every pet as if they were his own, combining compassionate care with invaluable education for pet owners. He takes the time to explain everything thoroughly, ensuring you understand not just the treatment but the "why" behind it.

A huge shoutout to the incredible staff for being so warm, welcoming, and kind. Your dedication does not go unnoticed! Keep up the amazing work, and thank you all again for everything you do. See you all again soon (hopefully not too soon =))

xo
Wonderful care for my pet! Total trust in their abilities.

The doctors and team are the most caring and understanding humans I've ever encountered. They've helped me through the most painful and difficult decision I've had to make for my best friend Ollie. They were kind and knowledgeable and the extra mile they went to make his last moments comfortable, is something I'll never forget.
Finally....a vet that goes above and beyond
Everyone there is so friendly and welcoming! They’re so nice to our pets.
I like that it is small, everyone is very nice, and sometimes I see a cat walking through which I like since I like cats. They treat my cat with kindness and excellent care.

Had to put my cat down very last minute, they got me in same day so she didn't suffer. The staff and the vet were amazing. Very compassionate. Michelle was so kind when I had to make an appointment for my senior dog just days after my cat passed away.
Kind, fair and so reasonable on price. They’ve helped my babies for years. I love them.

They are really nice and accommodating, but I took my cat there and they misdiagnosed him. My cat had an itchy ear, they said it was allergies. They gave him a fast and slow acting steroid shot, and some ear drops that I believe were antibiotic and steroid. Then 2 weeks later both of his ears were itchy, his eyes and nose were runny and I took him back. They said it was still allergies and gave him eye drops for a respiratory infection. Steroids lower the immune system so I'm pretty sure that triggered a respiratory infection. I just went to get a second opinion about his itchy ears and he DID have ear mites. I spent a total of 300 here. I gave him ear drops that were pretty uncomfortable for him to receive for something he didn't have. I found a different vet that treated him. So glad I got that second opinion
